designationHistory.indexText: The John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act established the Alabama Hills National Scenic Area in Inyo County, California.

authority.citation: Public Law 116-9, title I, sec. 1441 (adding title XIV, sec. 1402, to Public Law 103-433), 133 Stat. 701, 706

designationHistory.note: Enacted as a new title XIV of the California Desert Protection Act of 1994; the BLM unit page gives no designation date.
